items.evidence_text: The functionality of analytics core is to install a hook for window.fetch, XMLHttpRequest.open and XMLHttpRequest.send. This hook enables the extension to intercept requests made from the current webpage and any third-party scripts loaded on the page. The operator can also define intercept rules that can replace a URL with an operator’s own URL (e.g., to hijack software updates).

items.evidence_text: There are also inconsistent design choices that make little sense to a human developer. For example, the network hook for XMLHttpRequest checks for an HTTP response code greater than or equal to 200 but less than 300, while the hook for fetch checks against response.ok. Both result in the same outcome while the first is rarely, if ever, used when the response.ok shortcut exists.
